verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י מִקֵּ֣ץ׀ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֧ה שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת־ בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·qêṣ ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh ’ă·šer bā·nāh šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- bêṯ Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Now at the end of the twenty years during which Solomon had built the house of the LORD and his own palace
verses.literalPt: E SUCEDEU, ao fim de vinte anos, nos quais Salomão edificou a casa do SENHOR, e a sua própria casa,

verses.original: וְהֶעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן חוּרָם֙ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה בָּנָ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה אֹתָ֑ם וַיּ֥וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֖ם אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer nā·ṯan ḥū·rām liš·lō·mōh bā·nāh šə·lō·mōh ’ō·ṯām way·yō·wō·šeḇ šām ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Solomon rebuilt the cities Hiram had given him and settled Israelites . . . there
verses.literalPt: Que Salomão edificou as cidades que Hirão lhe tinha dado; e fez habitar nelas os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ חֲמָ֣ת צוֹבָ֔ה וַיֶּחֱזַ֖ק עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.literal: Then Solomon went to Hamath-zobah and captured it
verses.literalPt: Depois foi Salomão a Hamate-Zobá, e a tomou.

verses.original: וַיִּ֥בֶן אֶת־ תַּדְמֹ֖ר בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ עָרֵ֣י הַֽמִּסְכְּנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה בַּחֲמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- taḏ·mōr bam·miḏ·bār wə·’êṯ kāl- ‘ā·rê ham·mis·kə·nō·wṯ ’ă·šer bā·nāh ba·ḥă·māṯ
verses.literal: He built Tadmor in the wilderness in addition to all the store cities that he had built in Hamath
verses.literalPt: Também edificou a Tadmor no deserto, e todas as cidades de provisões, que edificou em Hamate.

verses.original: וַיִּ֜בֶן אֶת־ בֵּ֤ית חוֹרוֹן֙ הָֽעֶלְי֔וֹן וְאֶת־ בֵּ֥ית חוֹר֖וֹן הַתַּחְתּ֑וֹן עָרֵ֣י מָצ֔וֹר חוֹמ֖וֹת דְּלָתַ֥יִם וּבְרִֽיחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- bêṯ ḥō·w·rō·wn hā·‘el·yō·wn wə·’eṯ- bêṯ ḥō·w·rō·wn hat·taḥ·tō·wn ‘ā·rê mā·ṣō·wr ḥō·w·mō·wṯ də·lā·ṯa·yim ū·ḇə·rî·aḥ
verses.literal: He rebuilt Upper - and Lower Beth-horon as fortified cities with walls gates and bars
verses.literalPt: Edificou também a alta Bete-Horom, e a baixa Bete-Horom; cidades fortes, com muros, portas e ferrolhos;

verses.original: וְאֶֽת־ בַּעֲלָ֗ת וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ עָרֵ֤י הַֽמִּסְכְּנוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ עָרֵ֣י הָרֶ֔כֶב וְאֵ֖ת עָרֵ֣י הַפָּרָשִׁ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־ חֵ֣שֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשַׁק֙ לִבְנ֤וֹת בִּירֽוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ וּבַלְּבָנ֔וֹן וּבְכֹ֖ל אֶ֥רֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ba·‘ă·lāṯ wə·’êṯ kāl- ‘ā·rê ham·mis·kə·nō·wṯ ’ă·šer hā·yū liš·lō·mōh wə·’êṯ kāl- ‘ā·rê hā·re·ḵeḇ wə·’êṯ ‘ā·rê hap·pā·rā·šîm wə·’êṯ kāl- ḥê·šeq šə·lō·mōh ’ă·šer ḥā·šaq liḇ·nō·wṯ bî·rū·šā·lim ū·ḇal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn ū·ḇə·ḵōl ’e·reṣ mem·šal·tōw
verses.literal: as well as Baalath all the store cities that belonged to Solomon and all the cities for his chariots and horses - whatever . . . he desired to build in Jerusalem Lebanon and throughout the land of his dominion
verses.literalPt: Como também a Baalate, e todas as cidades de provisões, que Salomão tinha, e todas as cidades dos carros e as cidades dos cavaleiros; e tudo quanto, conforme ao seu desejo, Salomão quis edificar em Jerusalém, e no Líbano, e em toda a terra do seu domínio.

verses.original: כָּל־ הָ֠עָם הַנּוֹתָ֨ר מִן־ הַחִתִּ֜י וְהָאֱמֹרִ֤י וְהַפְּרִזִּי֙ וְהַחִוִּ֣י וְהַיְבוּסִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹ֥א מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hā·‘ām han·nō·w·ṯār min- ha·ḥit·tî wə·hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·hap·pə·riz·zî wə·ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî ’ă·šer lō mî·yiś·rā·’êl hêm·māh
verses.literal: As for all the people who remained of the Hittites Amorites Perizzites Hivites and Jebusites these people were not Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Quanto a todo o povo, que tinha ficado dos heteus, amorreus, perizeus, heveus e jebuseus, que não eram de Israel,

verses.original: מִן־ בְּנֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נוֹתְר֤וּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ כִלּ֖וּם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעֲלֵ֤ם שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְמַ֔ס עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: min- bə·nê·hem ’ă·šer nō·wṯ·rū ’a·ḥă·rê·hem bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer lō- ḵil·lūm bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘ă·lêm šə·lō·mōh lə·mas ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: their descendants who remained in the land those whom the Israelites . . . had not destroyed Solomon conscripted these people to be forced laborers as they are to this day
verses.literalPt: Dos seus filhos, que ficaram depois deles na terra, os quais os filhos de Israel não destruíram, Salomão os fez tributários, até ao dia de hoje.

verses.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא־ נָתַ֧ן שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה לַעֲבָדִ֖ים לִמְלַאכְתּ֑וֹ כִּי־ הֵ֜מָּה אַנְשֵׁ֤י מִלְחָמָה֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י שָׁלִישָׁ֔יו וְשָׂרֵ֥י רִכְבּ֖וֹ וּפָרָשָֽׁיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·min- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer lō- nā·ṯan šə·lō·mōh la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm lim·laḵ·tōw kî- hêm·māh ’an·šê mil·ḥā·māh wə·śā·rê šā·lî·šāw wə·śā·rê riḵ·bōw ū·p̄ā·rā·šāw
verses.literal: But Solomon did not consign any of the Israelites to slave labor because they were his men of war the leaders of his captains and the commanders of his chariots and cavalry
verses.literalPt: Porém, dos filhos de Israel, Salomão não fez servos para sua obra (mas eram homens de guerra, chefes dos seus capitães, e capitães dos seus carros e cavaleiros),

verses.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה שָׂרֵ֤י הַנְּצִיבִים אֲשֶׁר־ לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם הָרֹדִ֖ים בָּעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh śā·rê han·nə·ṣī·ḇīm ’ă·šer- lam·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh ḥă·miš·šîm ū·mā·ṯā·yim hā·rō·ḏîm bā·‘ām
verses.literal: They were also the chief officers for King Solomon 250 . . . supervisors . . .
verses.literalPt: Destes, pois, eram os chefes dos oficiais que o rei Salomão tinha, duzentos e cinqüenta, que presidiam sobre o povo.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ בַּת־ פַּרְעֹ֗ה הֶעֱלָ֤ה שְׁלֹמֹה֙ מֵעִ֣יר דָּוִ֔יד לַבַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽנָה־ לָ֑הּ כִּ֣י אָמַ֗ר לֹא־ תֵשֵׁ֨ב אִשָּׁ֥ה לִי֙ בְּבֵית֙ דָּוִ֣יד מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּי־ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֔מָּה אֲשֶׁר־ בָּֽאָ֥ה אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- baṯ- par·‘ōh he·‘ĕ·lāh šə·lō·mōh mê·‘îr dā·wîḏ lab·ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer bā·nāh- lāh kî ’ā·mar lō- ṯê·šêḇ ’iš·šāh lî bə·ḇêṯ dā·wîḏ me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl kî- qō·ḏeš hêm·māh ’ă·šer- bā·’āh ’ă·lê·hem ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh
verses.literal: Solomon brought the daughter of Pharaoh up from the City of David to the palace he had built for her For he said My wife . . . must not live in the house of David king of Israel because the places the ark of the LORD has entered are holy
verses.literalPt: E Salomão fez subir a filha de Faraó da cidade de Davi para a casa que lhe tinha edificado; porque disse: Minha mulher não morará na casa de Davi, rei de Israel, porquanto santos são os lugares nos quais entrou a arca do SENHOR.

verses.original: אָ֣ז הֶעֱלָ֧ה שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה עֹל֖וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה עַ֚ל מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י הָאוּלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz he·‘ĕ·lāh šə·lō·mōh ‘ō·lō·wṯ Yah·weh ‘al miz·baḥ Yah·weh ’ă·šer bā·nāh lip̄·nê hā·’ū·lām
verses.literal: At that time Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of the LORD he had built in front of the portico
verses.literalPt: Então Salomão ofereceu holocaustos ao SENHOR, sobre o altar do SENHOR, que tinha edificado diante do pórtico,

verses.original: וּבִדְבַר־ י֣וֹם בְּי֗וֹם לְהַעֲלוֹת֙ כְּמִצְוַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה לַשַּׁבָּתוֹת֙ וְלֶ֣חֳדָשִׁ֔ים וְלַמּ֣וֹעֲד֔וֹת שָׁל֥וֹשׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה בְּחַ֧ג הַמַּצּ֛וֹת וּבְחַ֥ג הַשָּׁבֻע֖וֹת וּבְחַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇiḏ·ḇar- yō·wm bə·yō·wm lə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ kə·miṣ·waṯ mō·šeh laš·šab·bā·ṯō·wṯ wə·le·ḥo·ḏā·šîm wə·lam·mō·w·‘ă·ḏō·wṯ šā·lō·wōš pə·‘ā·mîm baš·šā·nāh bə·ḥaḡ ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ ū·ḇə·ḥaḡ haš·šā·ḇu·‘ō·wṯ ū·ḇə·ḥaḡ has·suk·kō·wṯ
verses.literal: He observed the daily . . . requirement for offerings according to the commandment of Moses for Sabbaths New Moons and the three . . . annual appointed feasts the Feast of Unleavened Bread the Feast of Weeks and the Feast of Tabernacles
verses.literalPt: E isto segundo a ordem de cada dia, fazendo ofertas conforme o mandamento de Moisés, nos sábados e nas luas novas, e nas solenidades, três vezes no ano; na festa dos pães ázimos, na festa das semanas, e na festa das tendas.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֵ֣ד כְּמִשְׁפַּ֣ט דָּֽוִיד־ אָ֠בִיו אֶת־ מַחְלְק֨וֹת הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים עַל־ עֲבֹדָתָ֗ם וְהַלְוִיִּ֣ם עַל־ מִ֠שְׁמְרוֹתָם לְהַלֵּ֨ל וּלְשָׁרֵ֜ת נֶ֤גֶד הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ לִדְבַר־ י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֔וֹ וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֥ים בְּמַחְלְקוֹתָ֖ם לְשַׁ֣עַר וָשָׁ֑עַר כִּ֣י כֵ֔ן מִצְוַ֖ת דָּוִ֥יד אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mêḏ kə·miš·paṭ dā·wîḏ- ’ā·ḇîw ’eṯ- maḥ·lə·qō·wṯ hak·kō·hă·nîm ‘al- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯām wə·hal·wî·yim ‘al- miš·mə·rō·w·ṯām lə·hal·lêl ū·lə·šā·rêṯ ne·ḡeḏ hak·kō·hă·nîm liḏ·ḇar- yō·wm bə·yō·w·mōw wə·haš·šō·w·‘ă·rîm bə·maḥ·lə·qō·w·ṯām lə·ša·‘ar wā·šā·‘ar kî ḵên miṣ·waṯ dā·wîḏ ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: In keeping with the ordinances of his father David Solomon appointed the divisions of the priests over their service and the Levites for their duties to offer praise and to minister before the priests according to the daily . . . requirement He also appointed gatekeepers by their divisions at each gate . . . for this had been the command of David the man of God
verses.literalPt: Também, conforme à ordem de Davi seu pai, designou as turmas dos sacerdotes para seus ministérios, como também as dos levitas acerca dos seus cargos, para louvarem e ministrarem diante dos sacerdotes, segundo o que estava ordenado para cada dia, e os porteiros pelas suas turmas a cada porta; porque assim tinha mandado Davi, o homem de Deus.

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א סָרוּ֩ מִצְוַ֨ת הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ עַל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֛ם לְכָל־ דָּבָ֖ר וְלָאֹצָרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō sā·rū miṣ·waṯ ham·me·leḵ ‘al- hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim lə·ḵāl dā·ḇār wə·lā·’ō·ṣā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: They did not turn aside from the king’s command regarding the priests or the Levites in any matter including that of the treasuries
verses.literalPt: E não se desviaram do mandado do rei aos sacerdotes e levitas, em negócio nenhum, nem acerca dos tesouros.

verses.original: וַתִּכֹּן֙ כָּל־ מְלֶ֣אכֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה עַד־ הַיּ֛וֹם מוּסַ֥ד בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה וְעַד־ כְּלֹת֑וֹ שָׁלֵ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tik·kōn kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ šə·lō·mōh ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm mū·saḏ bêṯ- Yah·weh wə·‘aḏ- kə·lō·ṯōw šā·lêm bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Thus all the work of Solomon was carried out from the day the foundation was laid for the house of the LORD until it was finished So the house of the LORD was completed
verses.literalPt: Assim se preparou toda a obra de Salomão, desde o dia da fundação da casa do SENHOR, até se acabar; e assim se concluiu a casa do SENHOR.

verses.original: אָז֩ הָלַ֨ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה לְעֶצְיֽוֹן־ גֶּ֧בֶר וְאֶל־ אֵיל֛וֹת עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת הַיָּ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz hā·laḵ šə·lō·mōh lə·‘eṣ·yō·wn- ge·ḇer wə·’el- ’ê·lō·wṯ ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ hay·yām bə·’e·reṣ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: Then Solomon went to Ezion-geber and to Eloth on the coast . . . . . . of Edom
verses.literalPt: Então foi Salomão a Eziom-Geber, e a Elote, à praia do mar, na terra de Edom.

verses.original: וַיִּֽשְׁלַֽח־ לוֹ֩ חוּרָ֨ם בְּיַד־ עֲבָדָ֜יו אוֹנִיּוֹת וַעֲבָדִים֮ י֣וֹדְעֵי יָם֒ וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ עִם־ עַבְדֵ֤י שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אוֹפִ֔ירָה וַיִּקְח֣וּ מִשָּׁ֔ם אַרְבַּע־ מֵא֥וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים כִּכַּ֣ר זָהָ֑ב וַיָּבִ֖יאוּ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ- lōw ḥū·rām bə·yaḏ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ʾō·nī·yōṯ wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm yō·wḏ·‘ê yām way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘im- ‘aḇ·ḏê šə·lō·mōh ’ō·w·p̄î·rāh way·yiq·ḥū miš·šām ’ar·ba‘- mê·’ō·wṯ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm kik·kar zā·hāḇ way·yā·ḇî·’ū ’el- ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: So Hiram sent him ships captained by his servants along with crews of experienced sailors . . . They went with Solomon’s servants to Ophir and acquired from there 450 . . . . . . talents of gold which they delivered to King Solomon
verses.literalPt: E enviou-lhe Hirão, por meio de seus servos, navios, e servos práticos do mar, e foram com os servos de Salomão a Ofir, e tomaram de lá quatrocentos e cinqüenta talentos de ouro; e os trouxeram ao rei Salomão.
